run_game_tic_tac_toe: run the open_spiel example to play tic_tac_toe with random moves until terminal
list_registered_games: list all registered games using pyspiel.registered_games()
load_game_by_string: load a game by string name with parameters like breakthrough(rows=6,columns=6)
simulate_game_state: simulate a game state through chance nodes, simultaneous nodes, and decision nodes
get_game_returns: get player utilities after a game completes using state.returns()
